## `neuro.int32Array.map`

Instance method on `Int32Array.prototype`.

> Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that
> contains the results.

## Signatures

```ts
map(input: { int32Array: <receiver>; callbackfn?: (value: number; index: number; array: Int32Array) => number; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<Int32Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int32Array.prototype.map` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
